text_block_list.text: I am once again in your debt, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... for your kind words the
other day.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my path is clear and my

confidence restored.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: No longer am I blind to my own failings.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Besides, is there any race more fitting
than this to
mark the Emperor's rebirth?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Today, a new name will join the legends
who have
raced this track...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The name of Симболи Рудольф, the
Emperor!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
